item.title: “It’s Like a Sisterhood”: Two Colleagues Face Breast Cancer Together
item.itunes:author: CNN Podcasts
item.content:encoded:
Two cancer care professionals became patients themselves – and discovered just how powerful their friendship could be. Why a church parking lot could be your next home. A 2026 CNN Hero who once relied on food pantries is reimagining how Chicago families get the food they need. A 2024 study estimated that 52 million Americans struggle with loneliness – find out what CNN learned from experts about how to combat that. Plus, how a scheduling shakeup turned into a big win for fans at this year's WNBA Finals. 

Host/Producer: Krista Bo Polanco 

Producer: Eryn Mathewson  

Senior Producer: Felicia Patinkin 

Editorial Support: Kathleen Toner, Samantha Delouya, Don Riddell

item.title: How GOP Voting Restrictions Could Impact Turnout in Key Senate Races
item.itunes:title: How GOP Voting Restrictions Could Impact Turnout in Key Senate Races
item.itunes:author: CNN Podcasts
item.content:encoded:
In recent years, Republican-led legislatures have pushed through strict voting restrictions in a number of states that could determine the balance of the Senate this fall. We look at what voters are dealing with and how it could impact turnout on Election Day. 

--- 

Guest: Bob Ortega, CNN Investigates Senior Writer 

Host: David Rind 

Producer: Paola Ortiz 

Showrunner: Felicia Patinkin

item.title: How Elon Musk is Trying to Tip the Midterms — and Why Some Election Officials are Worried
item.itunes:title: How Elon Musk is Trying to Tip the Midterms — and Why Some Election Officials are Worried
item.itunes:author: CNN Podcasts
item.content:encoded:
When it comes to campaign spending, one person has spent more than anyone else: the trillionaire Elon Musk. However, some election officials believe his efforts to boost Republicans could be misleading voters. We look at what voters are seeing and how it could muddy the waters come Election Day. 

--- 

Guest: Fredreka Schouten, CNN National Political Writer 

Host: David Rind 

Producer: Paola Ortiz 

Showrunner: Felicia Patinkin
